commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; cd "$HOME/local-agent"; python3 - <<'PY'
import time
from agent_repository import load_repository_registry
import agent_repo_worker as w
import agentd
reg=load_repository_registry()
for r in reg:
    w.bind_repository(r)
    td=r.control/'.agent/tasks'; rd=r.control/'.agent/results'
    tasks=len(list(td.glob('*.json'))) if td.exists() else 0
    results=len(list(rd.glob('*.json'))) if rd.exists() else 0
    vals=[]
    for _ in range(5):
        t=time.perf_counter(); p=agentd.pending_tasks(); vals.append((time.perf_counter()-t)*1000)
    print(f'{r.repository_id}: tasks={tasks} results={results} pending={len(p)} pending_scan_ms={[round(x,2) for x in vals]}')
PY
